welcome.heroTitle: A free workout journal — no ads, no subscriptions
welcome.heroLead: Log sets and supersets in a couple of seconds, follow your progress on charts, record body measurements and build programs. Every feature is unlocked right after sign-up, and the built-in AI coach will suggest a new template for your goal.
welcome.heroNote: No card and no trial period. Your AI key stays in your browser.

noCost.title: €0 and no subscriptions
noCost.text: Every feature is available right after sign-up: no card, no trial period.

noAds.title: No ads
noAds.text: No banners, no pop-ups, no referral offers in the interface.

noPremium.title: No premium tiers
noPremium.text: Statistics, measurements, templates and the AI coach are available to everyone — nothing is locked behind a paywall.

pains.title: Sound familiar?
pains.turn: GymCore fixes this: you log the workout as you go, and your progress is calculated for you.

screenshots.text: A month later you cannot find anything in that pile.

measurements.title: Body measurements
measurements.text: Weight, chest, waist, biceps, hips, shoulders and more — with change history.

templates.text: Build a program once and start it in one click.

sharing.title: Program sharing

library.text: A ready-made library plus your own exercises. See which muscles are working.

ai.title: An AI coach that can see your history
ai.lead: Connect your own Gemini, Claude or GPT key — the assistant reads your workouts and the exercise library, picks the load and suggests a ready-made program template.

items.price: Completely free: no ads, no subscriptions and no premium tiers.
items.backup: Your data is not lost: there is a backup and a full-history export.
items.auto: Volume and progress are calculated for you — no pivot tables needed.
items.mobile: Built for your phone: large buttons and a dark theme right in the gym.
items.history: Statistics across your entire history, not just the last 10 workouts.
items.sharing: Programs can be shared as a link and installed in one click.

free.a: Yes, completely. The journal, statistics, measurements, program templates and the AI coach are available right after sign-up — no subscriptions, no ads and no premium tiers.

card.q: Do I need to enter a card or start a trial?
card.a: No. All you need is a username and a password: no payment details are requested and access is not time-limited.

internet.q: Do I need an internet connection?
internet.a: Yes — your data is stored in the cloud, so after logging in it is available from any device.

data.a: Into a secure database that only you can access. You can export your entire history to JSON at any time.

ai.q: What is the AI coach and do I need my own key?
ai.a: It is a built-in assistant. Connect a free Gemini key or a Claude/GPT key. The key is stored in your browser only and is never sent to our server.

app.a: GymCore is a web app: it opens in your phone browser and can be added to your home screen.

beginner.q: I am a beginner — is it for me?
beginner.a: Yes. There is a library of 312 exercises with anatomy and ready-made programs — you can start with those.

final.title: Start keeping your journal for free
final.text: Signing up takes 20 seconds: a username and a password, no card and no trial period. Your first workout can be today.

privacy.title: Privacy policy — GymCore
privacy.description: What data GymCore stores, why it is needed and how to delete it.
privacy.lead: Short and to the point: what data {site} stores, why it needs it and what happens to it.

bullets.account: Your username and password. The password is stored only as a cryptographic hash — it cannot be recovered.
bullets.workouts: Workout data: sets, weights, reps, dates, program templates and body measurements that you enter yourself.
bullets.media: Uploaded photos and videos — they are hosted in the Cloudinary cloud storage.
bullets.cookies: Service cookies: a session identifier and your device time zone (so that dates are shown in your local time).

aiKeys.title: AI keys
aiKeys.text: If you connect Gemini, Claude or GPT, your access key is stored in your browser only (in localStorage) and is sent directly to the provider along with the request. We do not store it and do not use it for any other purpose. You can delete the key at any time by clearing the site data in your browser.

purpose.title: Why we need it
purpose.text: The only purpose is to make the app work: signing you in, showing your history, calculating statistics and storing your data so that it is available from any device. We never sell your data or share it with ad networks.

publicLinks.title: Public links
publicLinks.text: If you share a program or an exercise yourself, that page becomes available via the link to anyone who has it. All other content is visible to you only.

retention.title: Storage and deletion
retention.text: Your data is stored for as long as your account exists. You can export your entire history to JSON in the profile settings at any time. To delete your account and the related data, write to us — we will delete it.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: If this policy changes, we will update this page. The version below is the current document.
